Download NOAA GOES ADP data

Source: R/source-goes.R
download_goes.Rd

Discover and download NOAA GOES-16 or GOES-18 Aerosol Detection Product (ADP) files from the NOAA Open Data Dissemination (NODD) AWS S3 archive. Files are in NetCDF format and contain aerosol detection variables (e.g. "Smoke", "Dust") on the GOES fixed geostationary grid.

Usage

download_goes(
  date = c("2024-01-01", "2024-01-01"),
  satellite = c("16", "18"),
  product = c("ADP-C", "ADP-F", "ADP-M"),
  directory_to_save = NULL,
  acknowledgement = FALSE,
  download = TRUE,
  remove_command = FALSE,
  show_progress = TRUE,
  hash = FALSE,
  max_tries = 20,
  rate_limit = 2
)

Arguments

date

character(1 or 2). Single date or inclusive range endpoints in "YYYY-MM-DD" format. Endpoints may be supplied in either order.

satellite

character(1). GOES satellite number: "16" (default) or "18". Selects one satellite per call.

product

character(1). ADP scan sector: "ADP-C" (CONUS, default), "ADP-F" (Full Disk), or "ADP-M" (Mesoscale). Selects one product per call.

directory_to_save

character(1). Non-empty output directory, created if needed. Files retain their S3 directory structure below this root; see Details.

acknowledgement

logical(1). Must be TRUE to proceed.

download

logical(1). Deprecated. FALSE warns and returns a preview after directory creation and discovery, without downloading data files. Discovery still queries S3 listings in preview mode. Default is TRUE.

remove_command

logical(1). Deprecated and ignored; TRUE warns. Default is FALSE.

show_progress

logical(1). Show per-file download progress. Default is TRUE; discovery and summary messages may still be printed when FALSE.

hash

logical(1). Return the combined directory MD5 hash when TRUE. Default is FALSE. Ignored when download = FALSE.

max_tries

integer(1). Maximum attempts per listing or file request, including the initial attempt. Default is 20.

rate_limit

numeric(1). Non-negative request-throttling interval in seconds, passed to discovery and downloads. Default is 2. Discovery uses a capacity-one bucket; 0 disables discovery throttling. File downloads follow the throttling policy in download_run_method().

Value

With download = FALSE, an invisible preview list containing urls, destfiles, and n_files. Otherwise, with hash = FALSE, the invisible summary from download_run_method(), including success, failed, and skipped counts. With hash = TRUE, a visible combined MD5 hash for all files under directory_to_save, including previously downloaded files.

The download summary always contains success, failed, skipped, failed_urls, and failed_files. The two failure vectors are character(0) when no files failed, including when every file was skipped.

Details

satellite and product are matched with base::match.arg(), allowing case-sensitive, unambiguous partial matches. Omitted arguments select the first listed choice. Products "ADP-C", "ADP-F", and "ADP-M" map to S3 prefixes "ABI-L2-ADPC", "ABI-L2-ADPF", and "ABI-L2-ADPM".

Daily listings supply the actual file names. Files are saved under directory_to_save/<product-prefix>/<year>/<day-of-year>/<hour>/<filename>. The day of year uses three digits, such as "001". Existing non-empty destination files are skipped by download_run_method(); preview results include them because discovery does not filter local files.

Discovery requests one S3 listing page of up to 1000 keys per day and keeps keys ending in .nc. Continuation tokens are not followed, so results can be incomplete when a daily listing spans multiple pages.

A successfully retrieved listing with no matching files emits a message and contributes no rows. Errors while requesting, parsing, or processing any listing stop discovery before downloading. Files are not required for every requested date. If all listings are empty, download = TRUE errors with "No URLs provided for download.", whereas download = FALSE returns an empty preview.

Discovery uses a 60-second timeout per request attempt. File downloads use download_run_method()'s default timeout of 3600 seconds.

Note

  • GOES data does not require authentication.

  • ADP-C (CONUS) scans are produced approximately every 5 minutes. A single day may contain several hundred files.

  • GOES ADP files use the GOES fixed geostationary projection. Use process_goes() to load and reproject to EPSG:4326.

See also

download_data(), process_goes(), download_run_method(), download_preview()

Author

Mitchell Manware

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
download_goes(
  date = "2024-01-01",
  satellite = "16",
  product = "ADP-C",
  directory_to_save = tempdir(),
  acknowledgement = TRUE
)
} # }
